messages.content: I would like a series-fed network if you can build one; otherwise retain the existing independent ports.

Physical synthesis for a series-fed network is not currently installed or supported in the runtime capabilities. Following your instruction, the existing configuration with four independent discrete ports is retained without changes.
What feed or excitation is actually modeled?

The model currently realizes an independent discrete port excitation for each element (strategy: independent_ports):

• Physical Ports: 4 individual 50 Ω discrete ports (port_1 through port_4), assigned respectively to array elements (1,1), (1,2), (2,1), and (2,2).
• Port Geometry: Vertical discrete ports connecting from the ground plane (z = 0 mm) to the local microstrip feed conductor (z = 1.6 mm) at the input of each patch.
• Element Feed Geometry: Each patch element features an integrated inset-fed microstrip line (feed width = 3.0 mm, inset depth = 8.64 mm, gap = 1.0 mm).
• Feed Network: There is no shared corporate or series transmission-line feed network physically modeled; each element is excited independently.
